Clustering

set.seed(123)

damage_coef2 = damage_coef %>% 
  select(damage_coef,gen)


damage_coef2 = damage_coef2 %>% 
  filter(!damage_coef >= 0)


dados_dummy <- model.matrix(~ gen - 1, data = damage_coef2)

set.seed(123)
dados_preparados <- cbind(dados_dummy, DC = damage_coef2$damage_coef)

set.seed(123)
resultado_kmeans <- kmeans(dados_preparados, centers = 3)
library(factoextra)

p = fviz_cluster(resultado_kmeans, data = dados_preparados,
        label = NULL,geom = "point",pointsize = 3, shape = 20)

p2 = p +
   theme_bw()+
  labs(x = "PC1",
       y = "PC2",
       title = "")+
  scale_color_manual(values = c('#7FBF7B','#D1BE91','#A6764D'))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c('#7FBF7B','#D1BE91','#A6764D'))+
    theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "center",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 20, b = 0, l = 0),  
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12,face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")  )

Economic losses

Group 1

set.seed(123)
sev = seq(0, 9,length.out = 100)
yld = seq(4000, 16000,length.out = 100)
b1 <- runif(100,min = 159.97, max = 430.21)
price_rice <- seq(300, 600,length.out = 10)

combined_data_g1 <- expand.grid(sev = sev, yld = yld, b1 = b1,price_rice = price_rice)


ylmer_simu_g1 = combined_data_g1 %>% 
  mutate(loss =((((((b1/11142.94)*sev)*100)*yld)/100)/1000)*price_rice)

ylmer_simu_g1$group = "Group 1"
ylmer_simu_g1$b0 = 11142.94

ylmer_simu_min2 = ylmer_simu_all %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  #mutate(loss =((((((b1/b0)*sev)*100)*yld)/100)/1000)) %>%
  mutate(loss =((((((b1/b0)*sev)*100)*yld)/100)/1000)*price_rice) %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
   mutate(pressure = case_when(sev > median(sev) ~ "High pressure",
                           sev <= median(sev) ~"Low pressure"),
          attainable = case_when(yld > median(yld) ~ "High yield",
                                 yld <= median(yld) ~"Low yield"))
ylmer_simu_min2 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(pressure,loss))+
  geom_boxplot(na.rm = F)
simu_summary <- ylmer_simu_min2 %>%
  group_by(group,pressure,attainable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_loss = mean(loss, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_low = quantile(loss, 0.025),
    ci_high = quantile(loss, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
pressure_cols <- c(
  "High pressure"  = "#6F3F1F",
  "Low pressure" = "#2E8B57")
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)   

dodge_w <- 0.45   # mantenha o mesmo valor usado nas outras camadas

interval2 <- ylmer_simu_min2 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = pressure, y = loss)) +
  
  # Intervalos (médias + IC) lado a lado por attainable
  geom_pointrange(
    data = simu_summary,
    aes(
      x        = pressure,
      y        = mean_loss,
      ymin     = ci_low,
      ymax     = ci_high,
      color    = pressure,
      linetype = attainable,
      group    = attainable
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    size = 1.0
  ) +
  
  # Ponto da média (opcional)
  geom_point(
    data = simu_summary,
    aes(
      x     = pressure, 
      y     = mean_loss,
      color = pressure,
      shape = attainable,
      group = attainable
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  
  # Texto da média alinhado ao seu respectivo intervalo (lado a lado)
  geom_text(
    data = simu_summary,
    aes(
      x     = pressure,
      y     = ci_high,  # posiciona o rótulo próximo à ponta superior do IC
      # Opção 1 (base R):
      label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_loss),
      # Opção 2 (scales): label = number(mean_loss, accuracy = 0.01),
      color = pressure,
      group = attainable
    ),
    position   = position_dodge(width = dodge_w),
    nudge_x    = 0.08,    # -> direita (ajuste fino conforme seu espaçamento)
    nudge_y    = 0.08,       # pequeno empurrão para não colar na barra
    hjust      = -0.1,          # à direita; ajuste conforme preferir
    vjust      = 1,       # ligeiramente acima da ponta do intervalo
    size       = 4,
    fontface   = "bold.italic"
    #, check_overlap = TRUE   # opcional para evitar sobreposição
  ) +
  
  # Escalas
  scale_color_manual(values = pressure_cols, name = "Pressure") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Low yield" = "solid", "High yield" = "dashed"),
                        name = "Attainable") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Low yield" = 16, "High yield" = 17),
                     name = "Attainable") +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 1)+
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Pressure level",
    y = "Economic losses (kg/ha)"
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14,face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

Economic damage threshold

# GROUP 1

set.seed(123)

DC_g1 <- 0.02
price_rice <- seq(300, 600,length.out = 200)
cost <- seq(40, 160,length.out = 200)
lambda = seq(0.40, 0.80,length.out = 200)

combined_data_g1 <- expand.grid(lambda = lambda, price_rice = price_rice,
                             cost = cost, DC = DC_g1)


EDT_simulated_g1 = combined_data_g1 %>% 
  mutate(EDT = (cost/(price_rice*DC))*lambda)

EDT_simulated_g1$group = "Group 1"
# GROUP 2

DC_g2 <- 0.02

combined_data_g2 <- expand.grid(lambda = lambda, price_rice = price_rice,
                             cost = cost, DC = DC_g2)


EDT_simulated_g2 = combined_data_g2 %>% 
  mutate(EDT = (cost/(price_rice*DC))*lambda)

EDT_simulated_g2$group = "Group 2"

# GROUP 3

DC_g3 <- 0.05

combined_data_g3 <- expand.grid(lambda = lambda, price_rice = price_rice,
                             cost = cost, DC = DC_g3)


EDT_simulated_g3 = combined_data_g3 %>% 
  mutate(EDT = (cost/(price_rice*DC))*lambda)

EDT_simulated_g3$group = "Group 3"

simu_all = rbind(EDT_simulated_g1,EDT_simulated_g2,EDT_simulated_g3)
simu_all %>% 
filter(EDT <=9) %>% 
  filter(cost <=120) %>%  
  summarise(
    min = min(EDT),
    max = max(EDT),
    mean = mean(EDT),
    quantile = quantile(EDT, 0.95)
  )
simu_all %>% 
 filter(EDT <=9) %>% 
  filter(cost <=120) %>% 
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    min = min(EDT),
    max = max(EDT),
    mean = mean(EDT),
    quantile = quantile(EDT, 0.95))
heat_EDT_all = simu_all %>%
 # filter(group == "Group 1") %>% 
  filter(EDT <=9) %>% 
  filter(cost <=120) %>% 
  #filter(lambda >= 0.75) %>% 
 # filter(lambda <= 0.76) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(lambda, cost, fill = EDT)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(40, 120, by = 20),
                     expand = c(0.02,0.02)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0.40, 0.80, by = 0.10),
                     expand = c(0,0)) +
  #scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(100, 600, by = 100)) +
scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = c("#2E8B57",   # dark brown
                "#7FBF7B",   # medium brown
                "#D1BE91",   # beige transition
                "#A6764D",   # light green
                "#6F3F1F"),  # dark green
    n.breaks = 6,             # number of steps (adjust for contrast)
    breaks = seq(0, 8, 1),
    name = "EDT",
    guide = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 6)   
  )
) +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 1)+
  
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    y = "Price (USD/ha)",
    x = "Control efficacy (%)"
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14,face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

set.seed(123)

b0_sim = seq(4000, 16000,length.out = 400)

#b1_sim <- runif(400,min = 567.31, max = 796.82)
#b1_sim <- runif(400,min = 192.59, max = 376.04)

b1_sim <- runif(400,min = 159.97, max = 796.82)


n <- 50000

S_seq <- 0:9


sim_df <- expand_grid(
    S = S_seq,
    b0 = b0_sim,
    b1 = b1_sim
) %>%
  mutate(
    Y  = b0 + b1 * S,
    Y0 = b0
  )

sim_df
tradeoff_df <- sim_df %>% 
  mutate(
     B0 = b0,
  DC = b1 / b0,
  B1 = b1
  )

tradeoff_df %>% 
  summarise(
quantile = quantile(DC, 0.95),
min = min(DC),
max = max(DC))
rainbow_dc =  tradeoff_df %>% 
  ggplot(aes(B0,DC, color = B1))+
  geom_jitter()+
  geom_smooth(se = F, color = NA)+
  theme_bw()+
   scale_colour_stepsn(
    colours = c("#2E8B57",   # dark brown
                "#7FBF7B",   # medium brown
                "#D1BE91",   # beige transition
                "#A6764D",   # light green
                "#6F3F1F"),  # dark green
    n.breaks = 6,             # number of steps (adjust for contrast)
    name = "Slope")+
   labs(x = "Attainable yield (kg/ha)",
       y = "Damage coefficient (%/p.p)")+
  theme_bw()+
    theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 20, b = 0, l = 0),  # Aumenta a margem à direita da legenda
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14,face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, vjust = 0.5)
  )+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(4000, 16000, by = 4000),
                     expand = c(0.02,0.02)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0.0, 0.20, by = 0.05),
                     expand = c(0.0,0.02))

rainbow_dc
group_pts <- data.frame(
  group = c("G1", "G2", "G3"),
  B0 = c(11142.9, 9692.0, 12368.3),  
  B1 = c(-292.8, -206.0, -682.3)     
)

group_pts$DC <- - group_pts$B1 / group_pts$B0


rainbow_dc2 = rainbow_dc +
 geom_point(
  data = group_pts,
  aes(B0, DC, shape = group),
  fill  = "orange",
  color = "black",
  size  = 4,
  stroke = 1.2
)+
guides(
  shape = guide_legend(title = NULL)
)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

set.seed(123)

b0_sim = seq(4000, 16000,length.out = 400)

#b1_sim <- runif(400,min = 567.31, max = 796.82)
#b1_sim <- runif(400,min = 192.59, max = 376.04)

b1_sim <- runif(400,min = 567.31, max = 796.82)


n <- 50000

S_seq <- 0:9


sim_df_g3 <- expand_grid(
    S = S_seq,
    b0 = b0_sim,
    b1 = b1_sim
) %>%
  mutate(
    Y  = b0 + b1 * S,
    Y0 = b0
  )

sim_df_g3$group = "Group 3"
sim_df_all = rbind(sim_df_g1,sim_df_g2,sim_df_g3)
sim_df_all = sim_df_all %>% 
   group_by(group) %>% 
   mutate(pressure = case_when(b1 > median(b1) ~ "High pressure",
                           b1 <= median(b1) ~"Low pressure"))

simu_DC <- sim_df_all %>%
  group_by(group,pressure) %>%
  mutate(
    B0 = b0,
  DC = b1 / b0,
  B1 = b1)

simu_DC %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  summarise(
quantile = quantile(DC, 0.95),
min = min(DC),
max = max(DC))
freq_dc = simu_DC %>% 
  ggplot(aes(DC))+
  geom_histogram(color = "white", bins = 15,fill = "black")+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(DC)), color = "orange", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 1)+
   labs(x = "Damage coefficient (%/p.p)",
       y = "Frequency")+
  theme_bw()+
    theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 20, b = 0, l = 0),  # Aumenta a margem à direita da legenda
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14,face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank())

df_r1$yield = b0 - b1*df_r1$sev - rep(u_j, each = 101)
df_r1$relative <- df_r1$yield *100 / b0

par_r1 = as.data.frame(b0)
par_r1$b1 = b1
par_r1$u_j = u_j
par_r1$group = "Group 1"

par_all = rbind(par_r1,par_r2,par_r3)

group_cols <- c(
  "Group 3"  = "#A6764D",
  "Group 2" = "#D1BE91",
  "Group 1" = "#7FBF7B")

b0_all = par_all %>% 
  ggplot(aes(b0, fill = group))+
  geom_histogram(colour = "white", bins = 12)+
  facet_wrap(~group)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols, name = "group") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(b0)), color = "black", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  theme_bw()+
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.1, 0.1),
                     limits = c(6000,14000),
                     breaks = c(6000,8000, 10000, 12000, 14000))+
  labs(x = "Attainble yield (kg/ha)",
       y = "Frequency")+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none")
